name: Nonprofit Program Operations
audience: small nonprofit direct-service and program teams
topic: participant follow-up and evidence workflows for nonprofit programs

products.name: Participant Follow-Up Queue
products.product: A minimal, permission-aware workflow for program follow-ups, referrals, missing steps, and outcome check-ins.
products.audience: small nonprofit direct-service and program teams
products.problem: Follow-up commitments are distributed across staff notes and spreadsheets, making it hard to see which participant is waiting and what consented action comes next.
products.valueProposition: Tracks the minimum necessary commitment, consent boundary, owner, next date, referral status, and outcome.
products.topic: nonprofit participant follow-up and referral tracking
products.monetization: $19-$79/month based on active records or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets nonprofit follow-up tracker, participant contact log, referral follow-up template, and program case workflow searches.

products.name: Grant Evidence Organizer
products.product: A source-linked evidence index that maps program activities and outcomes to reporting questions without becoming a second case-management system.
products.audience: small nonprofit direct-service and program teams
products.problem: Teams reconstruct grant reports from folders and spreadsheets because evidence is not linked to the reporting question, period, program, source, and reviewer.
products.valueProposition: Creates a traceable evidence inventory with ownership, permissions, gaps, review status, and report-ready summaries.
products.topic: nonprofit grant reporting evidence and outcome documentation
products.monetization: $19-$79/month based on active records or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets grant reporting checklist, nonprofit evidence tracker, program outcome documentation, and funder report workflow searches.
